details.description:
Data which needs to be added to the details and will be accessible during and after the {@DataValidation.Run} finishes.
If the returned details is empty, including an empty list (js/python) and empty value (null in js and None in python),
the rule can still pass and the details will also be empty.

title:
Type provided to the user lambda to send information to be converted into details. Please note that platform will ensure
that its processed and added to overall state.
